entries.name: Sticky jaws
entries.referenceMarkdown:
### Sticky jaws

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Agility. **Damage type:** physical.

**Weak defense:** Grappled 2. **Standard defense:** Grappled 1.

**Limit:** The holder suffers its own Grappled contribution. A new result replaces its lower contribution, not adds to it. Release freely; separation beyond reach, unconsciousness or death ends the hold.

details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Mimic Shell:** While still, resembles an ordinary object. Reason examination can expose it. Touching or opening it reveals the creature but grants no free attack; concealment is required to hide again.

**Healing:** Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** One chest in a damp cellar has no rot or dust on its hinges.

**Purpose:** Have food come close without a chase.

**Tactics and retreat:** Reveal itself when handled, then seize on its own turn; no free opening attack.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Test the object from a distance and keep a clear retreat.

**Habitat:** Dungeon; abandoned storehouse · **Communication:** None

**Loot:** 18 swallowed coins and one recoverable small object.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.

## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-mimic-chest


**Category:** Beast · **Role:** Ambusher · **CV:** 18

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sticky jaws | Brawn | None | 3 physical damage. | 4 physical damage. Grappled 1. | 6 physical damage. Grappled 2. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Ordinary attack difficulty; riders and positioning carry the threat.

**Reference damage:** 3/4/6

**Reference type:** physical

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.45

**Action review (#1279):** U 1.35 → 1.45: Maneuver allowance +0, Reaction allowance +0.1. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=4.000, O=3.162. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [Clinging Recoil](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/clinging-recoil.md), [mimic shell](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/mimic-shell.md), [seizing limbs](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/bdfd18ed535fbd0e1892b9344444abf6da644809/design/monster-abilities/seizing-limbs.md).

# Clinging Recoil

*Something catches the striking limb: a clutching hand, a string of slime or a fold of adhesive flesh that drags at the next hurried step.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-clinging-recoil

**Action:** Reaction

After an adjacent attacker’s attack resolves and deals HP damage to this creature, apply Slowed 2 to that attacker. This creature must survive and remain capable. No trigger from a free attack or another retaliatory effect. This grants no grapple, extra damage or equipment destruction.

# Mimic Shell

*The hinges are teeth; the leather grain shivers like skin.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-mimic-shell


**Action:** Passive

While still, this creature may resemble the ordinary object named in its entry. Reason search can expose the disguise using normal perception outcomes; touching or opening it reveals it before its next action, not a free attack. Once exposed, it needs concealment and a Hide action to become Hidden again.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.

# Seizing Limbs

*A coil or grasping limb closes around the target and braces against its struggling weight.*

## Rules

**ID:** monster-seizing-limbs


**Action:** Main Action

Use the printed attack. Standard also establishes Grappled 1; Strong establishes Grappled 2. A single holder’s contribution is replaced by its higher new result, not added to itself. Other holders stack normally. The holder suffers its own grapple contribution and cannot move while maintaining it. Release at any time without an action; death, unconsciousness or separation beyond the attack’s reach ends the hold. Force and external aid follow the core grapple rules.

**Limits:** Only creatures whose entries list this ability possess it. Printed
entry values and restrictions apply; no ability grants unlisted actions.
